## Hypothesis

The shotgun_scalper_stage4 keeper attempts to capture edge via HTF-gated directional scoring with tight stops (35% premium) and quick time stops (12 min). The edge_capture of 506.55 falls below the OP-16 rejection floor of 771, indicating failure to capture J's core edge despite high wide_pnl ($22,084.2). The strategy wins on J loser days (5/06: +$231, 5/07: +$95.85), violating the source-of-truth requirement to skip or lose less on loser days, suggesting overfit to non-J market noise.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** HTF-gated directional signal (volume ratio > 1.2) triggers ITM-2 put/call entry at mid-price.  
**Exit:**  
- Stop loss: 35% premium loss (hard stop)  
- Take profit: 75% premium gain (scale out 2/3 contracts)  
- Time stop: 12 minutes  
- Chandelier profit lock: arms at 60% gain, trails 15% off high-water mark  
- Contract size: 28 (per OP-20 disclosure baseline)
